G4986.name: Sopater
G4986.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G4986.brief: Companion of Paul from Berea, greeted the Roman church.
G4986.short: Sopater (or Sosipater) was a companion of Paul from Berea who accompanied him on his journey to Jerusalem and later sent greetings to the church in Rome.

G4988.name: Sosthenes
G4988.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G4988.brief: Synagogue ruler in Corinth, co-sender of 1 Corinthians.
G4988.short: Sosthenes was a synagogue ruler in Corinth who was beaten by a mob and later became a co-sender of Paul's first letter to the Corinthians.

G4941.name: Syntyche
G4941.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G4941.brief: Woman in the Philippian church whom Paul exhorted
G4941.short: Syntyche was a prominent woman in Philippi whom Paul urged to reconcile with Euodia.

G4965.name: Sychar
G4965.short: Sychar, a Samaritan city near Jacob's well, where Jesus spoke with a Samaritan woman (<ref="Jhn.4.5">Jhn.4.5</ref>).

G4946.name: Syracuse
G4946.brief: City in Sicily where Paul's ship stopped
G4946.short: Syracuse, a city on the island of Sicily where Paul's ship stopped for three days on his journey to Rome (<ref="Act.28.12">Act.28.12</ref>).

G4950.name: Syrtis
G4950.brief: Dangerous shallow waters off the coast of Libya
G4950.short: Syrtis, a dangerous area of shallow waters off the coast of Libya, feared by sailors (<ref="Act.27.17">Act.27.17</ref>).
